description:
When to call: before you connect to or recommend an MCP server, when you care whether its declared dependencies were observed dead or dormant in the lastseen.dev register.
Returns: dated facts, not a score: depends_on[], dead_dependency_count, dormant_dependency_count, n, provenance. Empty depends_on or zero counts means no dependency edges were on record for that id as of the response, not a guarantee of zero risk.
Example: {"id":"io.github.06ketan/medium-ops"}
id: MCP schema-server identifier whose dependency edges to inspect (e.g. io.github.owner/name).
name: dependency_risk
